greeting.npcText: May the light be with us, friend. How are you, fellow adventurer?

choices.text: I'm fine, prayer. Came to get blessed for battle.

textLocales.pt-BR: Estou bem, padre. Vim receber uma bênção para a batalha.
textLocales.en-US: I'm fine, prayer. Came to get blessed for battle.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: Que a luz esteja conosco, fiel. Como vão as aventuras?
npcTextLocales.en-US: May the light be with us, friend. How are you, fellow adventurer?

hungry.npcText: Eat and rest, for the love of god is forever, but you are not.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: Coma e descanse, pois o amor de Deus é eterno, mas você não.
npcTextLocales.en-US: Eat and rest, for the love of god is forever, but you are not.

hungry_done.npcText: Eat and rest, for the love of god is forever, but you are not.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: Coma e descanse, pois o amor de Deus é eterno, mas você não.
npcTextLocales.en-US: Eat and rest, for the love of god is forever, but you are not.

fine.npcText: The Lord doesn't want blood to be spilled. But I pray you'll return in peace 🙏.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: O Senhor não quer que sangue seja derramado. Mas eu rezo para que retorne em paz 🙏.
npcTextLocales.en-US: The Lord doesn't want blood to be spilled. But I pray you'll return in peace 🙏.

vendor.greeting: Haha! I know why you come here. Take a look at these fine crafts of mine. If you feel like selling stuff, I buy too!

pt-BR.name: Ferreira Loren
pt-BR.greeting: Haha! Eu sei por que veio até aqui. Veja minhas excelentes peças. Se quiser vender algo, também compro!

en-US.name: Blacksmith Loren
en-US.greeting: Haha! I know why you come here. Take a look at these fine crafts of mine. If you feel like selling stuff, I buy too!

npcs.name: Cecilia
npcs.greeting: Fate is a strange thing, isn’t it? It brought you to me and I have exactly what you came for. But isn’t it luck, though? Maybe…

pt-BR.name: Cecilia
pt-BR.greeting: O destino é uma coisa estranha, não é? Ele te trouxe até mim e eu tenho exatamente o que você veio buscar. Mas não seria sorte, afinal? Talvez…

en-US.name: Cecilia
en-US.greeting: Fate is a strange thing, isn’t it? It brought you to me and I have exactly what you came for. But isn’t it luck, though? Maybe…

npcs.name: Storage
npcs.monologue: You know I have a name, right? But you'll keep calling me Storage anyway...

pt-BR.name: Armazenamento
pt-BR.monologue: Você sabe que eu tenho um nome, não sabe? Mas continuará me chamando de Armazenamento de qualquer jeito...

en-US.name: Storage
en-US.monologue: You know I have a name, right? But you'll keep calling me Storage anyway...

npcs.name: Uncle Phillip
npcs.greeting: Hmmm… delicious… this might go well with tha - Oy! Young traveler! I know you have a great taste for food. You wanna use my kitchen? Fell free to, oy!

pt-BR.greeting: Hmmm, que delícia... isso deve harmonizar bem com ess - Oy! Jovem viajante! Sei que você tem um ótimo gosto para comida. Quer usar minha cozinha? Fique à vontade, oy!

en-US.name: Uncle Phillip
en-US.greeting: Hmmm… delicious… this might go well with tha - Oy! Young traveler! I know you have a great taste for food. You wanna use my kitchen? Fell free to, oy!

en-US.name: Pajé Piatã
